body:
Raised 2026-10-07 America/Los_Angeles by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affects PR #1286, immutable merge `9be99dfefb5871237ac464c6ef8a23e82be501f6`, submitted head `82de61e4e6e0e9fce012f298643fdd9d29abd098`. This is a new bounded additive follow-up for residual rejection gaps; preserve closed original #1279 and its budget/outcome. Original #1047 merge is `762d7b5a568ca845d85a98a4d188678c126a5d58`.

## Independently reproduced defects

The unchanged `verify-crosswalk.mjs` correctly validates the full 223-ID set and rejects the seven retained directed mutations, but two consequential source/disposition claims can still be forged while producing a successful output:

1. **Self-confirming source hash.** Assessment `source_artifact_sha256` is checked against the supplied crosswalk's `country_summary[country].source.sha256`, rather than the immutable native source descriptor used for the actual feature join. Set the AGO country-summary hash to 64 zeros and set all 157 AGO assessment source hashes to the same false value. Recompute `scope_reproduction_sha256` from the complete changed crosswalk bytes. The unchanged validator exits 0 and writes a success receipt, even though its own retained-source list records actual Angola SHA `44e58b2a8c2fefb9369294a32e2adde3e3637b9e02e8f1e2c53b400bec04f404`. None of the immutable source bytes changed. Whole-file digest binding does not establish correctness of these supplied source claims.
2. **Scientific disposition preservation is only aggregate.** The validator compares counts `{justified:0, correction-needed:1, insufficient-evidence:222}` but not each subject's original disposition. Set original correction subject `gb:MOZ:ADM2:85939544B59479814848654` / Cidade De Maputo to `insufficient-evidence`, and Angola subject `gb:AGO:ADM2:16411231B11923183554394` / Quela to `correction-needed`. Keep totals and all native/parent/name fields unchanged. The actual validator again exits 0 and writes a success receipt. Original acceptance explicitly requires preserving all 223 scientific dispositions and source uncertainty, not simply their aggregate count. The old original validator specifically rejected moving the correction away from Cidade De Maputo; this preservation invariant was lost.

These controls demonstrate rejection gaps, not false source hashes or altered classifications in the committed valid run products. Both retained valid crosswalk and assessment runs still match the original #1047 whole bytes exactly: crosswalk 217454B/SHA `70a1a813a415e6159d703a81be2e54af62fb7d638e5bd92f13449a970cc55d15`; assessments 417073B/SHA `9c08840cc0dd52d44f0efe5f03e67b4015607268d666b64efa4c300f1b859bb3`.

## Reproduction

Use Node 24.19.0 (actual Auditor runtime), Git, the exact merged validator and original retained inputs pinned below. The validator consumes original immutable Git baseline/source bytes itself. Run only in an admitted managed exact-merge review slot, with sanitized candidate environment and fresh bounded owned scratch outputs. Do not modify retained run or source files.

- Copy complete valid run-1 crosswalk and assessment JSON to fresh private fixtures.
- For case 1, set `crosswalk.country_summary.AGO.source.sha256 = "0".repeat(64)` and set `source_artifact_sha256` to that value on each assessment row whose country is AGO.
- Serialize the complete mutated crosswalk to the fixture file. Compute SHA-256 of those exact bytes and set `assessments.scope_reproduction_sha256` accordingly; serialize assessments to its fixture file.
- Execute the unchanged actual entry point: `node EXACT_VALIDATOR --crosswalk COMPLETE_FIXTURE --assessments COMPLETE_ASSESSMENT_FIXTURE --output FRESH_OWNED_OUTPUT`. Observed exit0 and emitted success output. Its authentic retained Angola source descriptor disagrees with the successfully accepted assessment hash.
- For case 2, use a separate complete valid fixture pair; change only the two per-ID classifications stated above. Preserve aggregate totals, subject roster, source fields, source-crosswalk digest and all other row data. Run the same real entry point into another fresh output. Observed exit0 and emitted success output.

The Auditor separately executed both valid run pairs (both pass) and all seven full retained mutation fixture pairs (all exit1 with no success output). No callbacks or substituted validator were used. All 20 manifest baseline whole-file pins were independently matched to actual immutable Git bytes. All 35 changed originals were authenticated at head/merge with modes. The full validator source/native/baseline/decoded/code/fixture/output operation was admitted below the 256MiB operation limit and each ordinary/decoded object below32MiB; no split/stream waiver. Actual immutable unique raw+decoded input bytes were 65184642.

## Scope and success criteria

- Own only the additive prefix in the work contract below; maximum two PRs, no implementation dependencies. Preserve all original packets, source bytes, IDs, geometry, dates, hashes, receipts, failed controls and closed #1279. Do not rewrite original PR1047/1286 evidence or broad current geography.
- Derive the full exact 223 subjects and their native source associations from original acceptance/frozen scope and independently authenticated immutable native collections and Atlas baseline. Bind each per-subject source-artifact descriptor to the actual consumed native source, including its path/bytes/hash. Candidate summaries or matching candidate assessment hashes cannot authenticate themselves.
- Preserve each subject's complete original scientific disposition and its unresolved rationale/source/role/parent/geometry limitations by ID. No arbitrary reassignment is justified by unchanged counts. A real scientific change belongs to separate authorized source work, not this validator-integrity repair. Preserve the original 0/1/222 totals and original Cidade De Maputo correction and all handoffs.
- Exercise the actual replacement entry point: both full valid pairs pass; the seven existing mutations and both new coherent mutations above reject before emitting a success receipt. Also test an individually incorrect source descriptor, wrong original disposition and missing/extra/duplicate scientific subjects while totals/hashes are refreshed coherently. Independent expectations must come from the frozen originals, not candidate booleans.
- Bind actual consumed code/input bytes once to the checked output; authenticate whole-file descriptors and relations. Run complete admitted valid reproductions twice into fresh owned destinations, retain successful and failed whole-byte evidence, admit outputs before computation and reject existing file/directory, symlink/traversal escape and partial-success cases. No retained output overwrite or receipt-only substitution for actual execution. Ordinary and decoded objects<=32MiB, complete unique raw+decoded inputs/code/fixtures/results<=256MiB.
- Publish explicit limits and independent exact-head source/method verification. This repair verifies source/assessment integrity only; no territorial approval, current-boundary/legal conclusion, source acquisition, import or deployment. Existing scientific #1042/#1045/#1046/#896/#1223 and the parent #411 remain separate work; they are not prerequisites to this mechanical repair.

## Deduplication, ownership and limits

Authenticated complete all-state inventory:1458 entries,14 pages100 plus58. Complete affected namespace history contains only original merge #1286; both current open PRs had complete file pagination and no affected overlap. The closed #1279 addressed the original missing-crosswalk-member problem and #1286 already fixes that directed case; do not reopen1279 to append this residual defect. No existing scoped issue covers the demonstrated false native-source digest and displaced scientific-disposition cases. All existing parsed work contracts were checked for overlapping parent/nested ownership of the proposed new prefix; none overlaps. No foreign claim or original issue state is changed. Shared read-only readiness must be complete/eligible and current issue/ownership reread before adding ready.

The Auditor has not independently rerun the original crosswalk/assessment producers in this phase, the entire historical control runner/receipt/manifest builder, source factual/legal geography work, all file-drift/destination adverse cases or proof-publication boundaries. Those remain explicit #1286 Incomplete scope. The verified rejection defects above are actionable without pretending that unexecuted scope is complete.
